title: Create 3D density grid (Texture3D<float> UAV) and debug slice
summary: Add a GPU 3D density volume with UAV write + SRV read, fill it with a simple analytic field via compute, and render a debug slice to confirm correctness.
motivation: Content-first: establish volumetric data source to unblock ray marching and lighting.
scope: Add Texture3D<float> density volume, default size 128^3, presets 96/128/192/256
Allocate SRV+UAV descriptors via DescriptorHeap allocator
Add compute shader density_fill.hlsl (cs_6_0) to generate simple analytic density (e.g., noisy sphere/torus)
Add optional particles_splat (deferred) hook to accumulate from particles later
Add a minimal debug pass to slice the volume (Z slice) into HDR to visually validate
Add CMake DXC compile steps and copy to output
Add logs for descriptor indices and transitions; throttle logs to avoid spam
steps: Resource: Create Texture3D with DXGI_FORMAT_R16_FLOAT, D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_UNORDERED_ACCESS, initial state UAV.
Descriptors: Allocate SRV and UAV indices; create views (SRV: Texture3D, UAV: Texture3D).
Shader: density_fill.hlsl → writes to RWTexture3D<float> density; numthreads=8,8,8; inputs: time, bounds, center, scale.
Dispatch: grid = ceil(dim/8); ensure HDR is not overwritten in same frame (compute writes to density only).
Debug slice: density_slice.hlsl (optional) or reuse a simple compute to write one Z slice mapped to HDR.
Barriers: After density UAV writes, insert UAV barrier. For sampling (if preview shader reads density), transition density to SRV. Return to UAV next frame if writing again.
CMake: Add custom commands for density_fill.dxil (and density_slice.dxil if used).
Logs: On creation, print resolution + descriptor indices; on dispatch every ~60 frames, print a heartbeat.
acceptance_criteria: On run, a visible grayscale/colored slice appears and changes with time.
Logs show density resource creation with SRV/UAV descriptor indices.
PIX capture shows correct UAV→SRV barriers before sampling; no allocator reset or device removal.
Changing preset via F3 re-creates the 3D texture and updates the debug slice accordingly.
notes: Prefer R16_FLOAT to keep memory reasonable at 256^3.
Keep density in UAV state by default; transition to SRV only when read in the same frame.
If particles splat is not ready, the analytic field alone is sufficient for validation.
